title: LoL Esports Community Competition Guidelines
summary: LoL Esports Community Competition Guidelines  LoL Esports
content:
We're making it easier than ever to organize League of Legends community competitions. Our updated global guidelines remove outdated restrictions, streamline licensing into a single community competition framework, and reduce restrictions on entry fees, sponsorships, prize pools, and spectator fees. In most cases, organizers will no longer need to wait for Riot approval to run an event. Follow the guidelines, submit your competition through ourvisibility form(pw: riotevent), and start building for your community.

Whether you're organizing a local LAN, a college tournament, or an online bracket, these guidelines are designed to support community competition across the evolving League of Legends experience, including Summoner's Rift, ARAM, Arena, League of Legends Classic, and future experiences.

You're free to organize League of Legends competitions at nearly any scale, whether that's a local LAN at your PC café, a school or university, an online community competition, an open bracket, or a larger invitational event. We want to support community competition across League's growing ecosystem of game modes, including Summoner's Rift, Arena, League Classic, and future experiences.

These guidelines are designed for community organizers operating independently and in good faith. However, some organizations are not covered under this community competition license and will need to work directly with Riot through a separate process.

We know community competitions take time, effort, and resources to run, and we want organizers to have the flexibility to build sustainable events. There are no fixed caps on entry fees, sponsorship revenue, prize pools, or spectator ticketing under these guidelines.

We do ask organizers to act reasonably, provide fair value to players, fans, and partners participating in the event, and avoid misleading or deceptive practices. While we have removed many of the previous restrictions, certain sponsor categories remain off-limits. You can find the full list of restricted sponsors below in the “What types of sponsors should I avoid making agreements with?” section.
